"""Create synthetic pre-consolidation vectors, never touch an existing store.

This is a one-time preservation producer, not a live certificate or a future
test oracle. Every imported dpone/test producer must match the frozen commit.
Only a newly created private output directory may receive generated fixtures.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], text=True).strip())
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from dpone.adapters.clickhouse_authority_sqlite import SQLitePublicationAuthority
from dpone.adapters.clickhouse_publication_codec import decode_record, encode_record
from dpone.contracts.clickhouse_native_publication import NativePublicationCompletion
from dpone.contracts.clickhouse_publication import PublicationRecord, PublicationState, choose_publication
from tests.test_clickhouse_candidate_sqlite import (
    complete_create,
    completion,
    enrollment,
    mutation,
    request,
    store,
)
from tests.test_clickhouse_publication_codec import example_record

SOURCE_COMMIT = "5a36601e26fb826ed4ea1b4a08aca722d366ffec"


def source_manifest() -> dict[str, str]:
    manifest = {}
    for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
        source = getattr(module, "__file__", None)
        selected = name in {"dpone", "tests"} or name.startswith(("dpone.", "tests.test_clickhouse_"))
        if source is None or not selected:
            continue
        path = Path(source).resolve()
        if path.suffix != ".py":
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        original = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{SOURCE_COMMIT}:{relative}"], cwd=ROOT)
        actual = path.read_bytes()
        if original != actual:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Producer differs from frozen source: {relative}")
        manifest[relative] = hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()
    return dict(sorted(manifest.items()))


def create_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def freeze_records(destination: Path) -> None:
    observed = example_record().intent.before
    assert observed.target is not None and observed.candidate is not None
    cases = {
        "replace_partition": observed,
        "rename": replace(observed, target=None),
        "noop": replace(observed, candidate=replace(observed.target, uuid="new")),
        "exchange": replace(observed, candidate=replace(observed.candidate, design_digest="d" * 64)),
    }
    states = (
        (PublicationState.PREPARED, False),
        (PublicationState.CLAIMED, True),
        (PublicationState.UNKNOWN, False),
        (PublicationState.UNKNOWN, True),
        (PublicationState.COMMITTED, True),
        (PublicationState.NOT_PUBLISHED, False),
    )
    vectors = []
    for method, observation in cases.items():
        intent = choose_publication("deployment:one", observation)
        assert intent.method == method
        for state, claimed in states:
            value = PublicationRecord(intent, state, claimed)
            payload = encode_record(value)
            assert decode_record(payload) == value
            vectors.append({"method": method, "state": state, "claim_granted": claimed,
                            "encoded": payload, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()})
    create_json(destination / "publication-records.json", vectors)


def freeze_v1(destination: Path, phase: str) -> None:
    private = destination / f"v1-{phase}"
    private.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    path = private / "authority.db"
    SQLitePublicationAuthority.provision(path, "deployment")
    authority = SQLitePublicationAuthority(path, "deployment")
    value = request()
    binding = authority.acquire(value.operation_id, value.subject, value.candidate)
    entry = authority.prepare(binding, example_record().intent)
    if phase != "prepared":
        grant = authority.claim(entry)
        assert grant is not None
        authority.begin_send(grant)
        if phase == "terminal":
            receipt = NativePublicationCompletion(value.operation_id, entry.record.intent.query_id, "server",
                                                  "b" * 64, (24, 8, 14), 54468, "0.2.10")
            authority.record_terminal(grant, receipt.digest)
            create_json(destination / "native-completion.json", {"fields": asdict(receipt), "digest": receipt.digest})
    create_json(destination / f"v1-{phase}-diagnostics.json", authority.diagnostics(value.operation_id))


def freeze_v2(destination: Path, phase: str) -> None:
    private = destination / f"v2-{phase}"
    private.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    authority = store(private)
    value = request()
    with authority.enroll(value, enrollment(value)) as invocation:
        writes = complete_create(authority, invocation)
        insert = mutation(invocation, "insert", 1)
        grant = writes.register(invocation, insert)
        writes.begin_send(grant)
        if phase == "closed":
            receipt = completion(insert)
            writes.record_terminal(grant, receipt)
            authority.source_exhausted(invocation)
            authority.close_admission(value.operation_id)
            create_json(destination / "candidate-completion.json", {"fields": asdict(receipt), "digest": receipt.digest})
    create_json(destination / f"v2-{phase}-diagnostics.json", authority.diagnostics(value.operation_id))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("destination", type=Path)
    destination = parser.parse_args().destination.absolute()
    initial_sources = source_manifest()
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o700)  # Deliberately fails when output already exists.
    freeze_records(destination)
    for phase in ("prepared", "may-have-sent", "terminal"):
        freeze_v1(destination, phase)
    for phase in ("may-have-sent", "closed"):
        freeze_v2(destination, phase)
    final_sources = source_manifest()
    if any(final_sources.get(path) != digest for path, digest in initial_sources.items()):
        raise RuntimeError("Producer changed while freezing history")
    with (destination / "producer.py.txt").open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    files = {path.relative_to(destination).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
             for path in sorted(destination.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()}
    create_json(destination / "provenance.json", {
        "source_commit": SOURCE_COMMIT, "producer_sources": final_sources,
        "producer_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "python": platform.python_version(), "sqlite": sqlite3.sqlite_version,
        "kind": "synthetic_pre_consolidation_fixtures", "live_certificate": False,
        "coverage": "24 publication JSON variants, 3 v1 and 2 v2 quiesced synthetic stores; no seal or v3",
        "limitations": "Synthetic positive completion only; no actual transport or EOS proof; random grant hashes are frozen bytes, not reusable grants",
        "files_sha256": files,
    })
    print(json.dumps({"destination": str(destination), "files": len(files), "source_files": len(final_sources),
                      "source_commit": SOURCE_COMMIT, "live_certificate": False}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
